subject: Cognitive Science
title: Functional Fixedness
description: A short lesson to help you apply Functional Fixedness.

hook.text: You need a candle holder. There's a box of thumbtacks on the table. Can you see the solution?

buildup.text: Duncker's candle problem: pin the box to the wall and use it as a shelf. Most people miss it.

discovery.text: Functional fixedness: we see objects only in their usual role. The box is a container, not a shelf.

twist.text: Empty the tacks from the box and people solve it easily. Seeing the box as a container blocks creativity.

climax.text: Innovation often means seeing familiar tools in unfamiliar ways. The function you assign limits what you see.

punchline.text: An object is more than its usual use.

quiz.question: What is functional fixedness?
options: Seeing objects only in their typical function
